# Tests (DeepInit)

- Engine behaviour is pinned against fixture worlds in `tests/fixtures/worlds.ts` and `village.json`, never against live content (`tests/fixtures/worlds.ts:4`).
- `content.test.ts` runs the real validator over live JSON and over deliberately broken variants.

- The departed-id test covers `items` only (`tests/persistence.test.ts:70-80`).
- There are no UI unit tests; `bun run smoke` covers the UI.
